name: Count items in array
description: Writes the number of items at an array path into a target field. Use for 'how many adults?' / 'how many flights?' / 'how many bundles?' patterns. Pair with a number filter to express 'if there are 2+ adults'.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Path to the array to count.

params.name: target
params.description: Field on the current record (or context key) to write the count into.
